howItWorks.title: Three steps.
howItWorks.step1.title: Open Stash
howItWorks.step1.body: Click the extension icon while browsing. Your current tabs appear instantly.
howItWorks.step2.title: Save or share
howItWorks.step2.body: Hit "Save session" to store locally, or "Copy link" to share your exact context.
howItWorks.step3.title: Restore anytime
howItWorks.step3.body: Open any saved session with one click. Tabs reopen exactly as you left them.
